nodes.label: GM Animated Logo Badge
nodes.description: 512x512 animated SVG badge with rounded-rectangle shape (rx=116), dark navy gradient background, golden ring, GM serif text, and shimmer sweep. Represents GeneralModern brand identity.

nodes.label: Navy Background Gradient
nodes.description: Linear vertical gradient from #22324f (dark navy blue) to #141f33 (near-black navy), used as badge background fill.

nodes.label: Gold Gradient
nodes.description: Diagonal linear gradient from warm champagne #f7e9a6 through golden #e3c163, #c79a33, to deep antique gold #a87b1f. Used for ring stroke and GM text fill.

nodes.label: Shine Sweep Gradient
nodes.description: Horizontal white transparency gradient (opacity 0 → 0.5 → 0) used to create a light sweep shimmer effect over the badge.

nodes.label: Badge Pop-In Animation
nodes.description: CSS keyframe animation gmpop: badge scales from 0.55 to 1.05 (overshoot) then settles at 1.0, fading in from opacity 0 to 1. Duration 0.7s, custom cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1), fill-mode both.

nodes.label: Ring Draw Animation
nodes.description: CSS keyframe animation gmdraw: animates stroke-dashoffset from 1098 to 0 to reveal the golden ring as if drawn. Duration 1.1s, ease, 0.25s delay.

nodes.label: GM Letters Fade-In Animation
nodes.description: CSS keyframe animation gmletters: GM text slides up from translateY(22px) and scale(0.88) to natural position/scale while fading in from opacity 0 to 1. Duration 0.6s, ease, 0.55s delay.

nodes.label: Shimmer Sweep Animation
nodes.description: CSS keyframe animation gmsweep: a rotated white-gradient rectangle sweeps horizontally across the badge from translateX(-540px) to translateX(540px) with 18deg tilt. Infinite loop, 2.8s, ease-in-out, 1.3s initial delay. Creates premium shimmer/gloss effect.

nodes.label: Golden Circle Ring
nodes.description: Circular stroke (r=182) centered at 256,256 with gold gradient stroke, stroke-width 10, round linecap. Rotated -96 degrees for artistic starting position. Drawn via stroke-dashoffset animation.

nodes.label: GM Logotype Text
nodes.description: Large serif 'GM' text centered at (256, 312), font-size 172, font-weight 700, letter-spacing -6, filled with gold diagonal gradient. Represents General Modern brand initials in Georgia/Times New Roman serif typeface.

nodes.label: GeneralModern Brand Identity System
nodes.description: Complete animated logo representing GeneralModern (generalmodern.uz) brand: dark navy + gold premium color scheme, serif GM initials, circular ring, shimmer sweep. Staged animation sequence: badge pop (0s) → ring draw (0.25s) → letters appear (0.55s) → shimmer loops (1.3s+). Premium/luxury warehouse brand aesthetic.
